name: Heptasuchus
sum: Heptasuchus is a loricatan pseudosuchian from the Triassic of Wyoming, the first formally recognised rauisuchian from North America.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: UW 11562, a partial skull and associated postcranial skeleton from the Clark locality north-west of Casper, Wyoming (collected 1977).
material: The holotype and paratypes UW 11563-11565 (partial cranial and postcranial remains); the specimens were thought lost until 1997 and mostly reside at the University of Wyoming.
biology: The sources consulted describe its discovery and anatomy but give no direct evidence of diet or habits.
author: Dawley et al. 1979
